name: Krazy Get Down Boys
description: The Almighty Krazy Get Down Boys (KGDB) are a Chicago street gang based in the Ashburn neighborhood on the Southwest Side, active since the 1990s. They operate in the area around 77th to 79th Street between Cicero and Tripp, including the Rainey Park area. The KGDB are affiliated with the Almighty family of Chicago street gangs.
